description: This file defines the LoginModel class for the Identity Pages of an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages web application. It manages user login functionality, including handling login requests, managing external authentication schemes, and transferring anonymous shopping basket data upon successful login.

classes.name: LoginModel
classes.description: Handles user login page logic, including login process, external authentication schemes, and basket transfer upon login.

classes.name: InputModel
classes.description: Represents the login form data, including email, password, and remember-me option.

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Prepares the login page, initializes external login schemes, and handles error messages.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles login POST requests, performs authentication, manages account lockout, and redirects upon success.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketToUserAsync
methods.description: Transfers an anonymous shopping basket to the logged-in user after successful authentication.
